positive.why: UNION ALL тоже подходит: полных дублей в данных нет
positive.sql: SELECT id AS object_id, pizza_name AS object_name FROM menu UNION ALL SELECT id, name FROM person ORDER BY object_id, object_name;
SELECT id AS object_id, pizza_name AS object_name FROM menu UNION SELECT id, name FROM person ORDER BY 1, 2;

negative.sql: SELECT id, pizza_name FROM menu UNION SELECT id, name FROM person ORDER BY 1, 2;
SELECT id AS object_id, pizza_name AS object_name FROM menu ORDER BY 1, 2;
SELECT id AS object_id, pizza_name AS object_name FROM menu UNION SELECT id, name FROM person ORDER BY object_name, object_id;
